newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures slightly cut gains after auction.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures slightly cut gains after auction.

text.p: Feb 13 - U.S. debt futures slightly cut gains but most remained higher, after results of the 30-year T-bond auction.
The sale produced an average yield of 6.640 pct, a two-basis-point tail, a 2.42 bid/cover and $318 million non-competitive bids. Traders had expected an average yield of 6.63 percent.
